## Summary

Adds the first two shared agent skills for working group chairs. They're converted from the Security & Privacy WG's existing prompts and made generic, so any AAIF working group can use them.

## Skills

- **`aaif-wg-meeting-notes`** turns a meeting's AI summary and transcript into notes in the standard template: topics discussed, decisions, deliverables, action items, and links to the AI summary, transcript, and recording.
- **`aaif-wg-monthly-report`** drafts the monthly report to the TC from the month's meeting notes, the WG repo's GitHub activity, and last month's report, and writes it to `reporting/YYYY-MM-report.md`. The chair reviews the draft and opens the report PR.

Each skill is a folder with a `SKILL.md` (instructions for the agent) and a `template.md` (the output format). Both only load when named explicitly, for example: "Using the aaif-wg-meeting-notes skill, write the notes for the 3-17 meeting."

## Using them

Copy a skill folder into your agent's skills directory (for example `~/.cursor/skills/` or `~/.claude/skills/`), then name the skill in your request.

## Notes for reviewers

- Neither skill has been run on real meeting material yet.
- The monthly report template's Ecosystem Highlights guidance still uses security examples (OWASP, AARM, MCP ACS). They're marked "e.g.", but other WGs may want to swap in their own.
